earnings.title: APA Corporation announces third-quarter 2026
highlights: APA reported net income attributable to common stock of $698 million, or $2.00 per diluted share.
Generated $1.38 billion of net cash provided by operating activities, $699 million of free cash flow, and $1.86 billion of adjusted EBITDAX;
Returned $537 million to shareholders including $450 million of share repurchases;
Free cash flow totaled $699 million, bringing year-to-date free cash flow to $1.91 billion.
outlook: Increased full-year 2026 free cash flow outlook to approximately $2.9 billion, reflecting stronger operating performance and higher commodity prices;
Gross gas production increased to 542 million cubic feet (MMCF) per day, exceeding guidance through strong well performance and more resilient base production.

Upstream capital investment was $466 million, approximately $30 million below guidance, primarily reflecting timing impacts of GranMorgu capital spending that shifted into the fourth quarter; lease operating expense was $418 million.
